delta.message: feat(135-S/126-F): adopt the backlogit .backlog storage root

delta.comment: STAGE P2 ANOMALY RESOLUTION 2026-08-15 (dark-factory P-017; route claude-opus-5/anthropic/high). Resolving the torn-log anomaly recorded in docs/closure/135-S-126-F-post-merge-closure.md (Follow-Ups, P2, owned by Stage). OBSERVED STATE: .backlogit/logs/018-DL.jsonl (untracked) contains commit_tracked(9851cc3d) at 14:01:26 and archived(archive_path=.backlogit/archive/018-DL.md) at 14:01:58, but .backlogit/archive/018-DL.md DID NOT EXIST and .backlogit/queue/018-DL.md remained present with status: queued and byte-identical to its committed version (git ls-files confirms only queue/018-DL.md is tracked; git log shows archive/018-DL.md was never added in any commit). ROOT CAUSE (external, read-only evidence): backlogit emits archival lifecycle events through its pre-archive hook path before the artifact file move is durably completed (internal/core/archive.go documents the 066.003-T collision guard as running deliberately "before the pre-archive hooks fire and before any file is written -- so a refused archive has no side effects", which implies a failure or interruption AFTER hook emission can leave emitted events with no corresponding file mutation). This is an external backlogit event/durability-ordering gap, not an autoharness defect; C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit was NOT mutated (read-only inspection only) and NO synthetic or hand-authored log entry was written here. ARCHIVAL DECISION: ARCHIVE, and archive now. (1) This deliberation's Chosen Direction items (a) shared storage-root resolution helper, (b) schema updates, (c) template/instruction/agent/CI/doc updates and (d) tune-harness detect-and-report drift rule are ALL DELIVERED by feature 126-F / shipment 135-S, shipped and archived via PR #345 (merge 9851cc3d, main 65ca1b23). (2) Item (e) -- migrating THIS repository's own .backlogit storage root and flipping .autoharness/backlog-registry.yaml -- was recorded in this deliberation as an EXPLICIT EXCLUSION from the chosen direction, not as deferred work owned by this deliberation; it is tracked on stash BED0DDED, which REMAINS ACTIVE as the living tracker, so archiving 018-DL loses no tracking. (3) Both Open Questions were answered in-artifact (registry must keep describing the CURRENT workspace; tune-harness must never auto-run backlogit migrate --workspace-dir), so no unanswered decision is stranded. (4) Leaving 018-DL queued misrepresents fully-shipped planning work as available and risks a future Stage session re-deliberating it. (5) Precedent: 010-DL and 011-DL were both archived directly from queued (archived_status: queued), so no artificial status transition is required or performed. (6) This archival is NON-DESTRUCTIVE -- the artifact file is moved to .backlogit/archive/018-DL.md, nothing is deleted, and .backlogit/logs/018-DL.jsonl is preserved untouched and append-only; the pre-existing 14:01:58 archived event is deliberately NOT rewritten or removed. After this archival the previously-false archived claim becomes TRUE and artifact state and log history are coherent, which is exactly the "deliberately-reviewed Stage archival" the closure named as the sanctioned resolution (as opposed to the regression it warned against: committing the log with no corresponding Stage archival). FOLLOW-UP RECORDED (P3, external, non-blocking): backlogit archive event emission is not atomic with the artifact file move; captured as a bounded external observation only -- no autoharness fix is fabricated and no upstream mutation is performed.
